title: Neymar's Injury Status Ahead of World Cup Match
summary: Reports suggest Brazilian star Neymar may miss the upcoming FIFA World Cup match against Scotland due to injury concerns, with coach Carlo Ancelotti reportedly keeping his medical card close. While some outlets focus on the potential lineup changes and Brazil vs Scotland matchup in Miami, others highlight that Neymar has returned from an earlier injury for this specific fixture.
summary_points: Reports indicate Neymar might be absent from the World Cup match against Scotland due to ongoing health concerns.
